Test Objective: Verify the SS-001 valid security control: a valid JWT carrying role = 'admin' is authenticated and authorized for a documented order transition.
Preconditions: A controlled existing order is in pending; a valid Admin JWT fixture is available; record the target order state before the request.
Request Input: Path id: <existing-pending-order-id>; Authorization: Bearer <valid-admin-JWT>; JSON body: {"status":"confirmed"}.
Expected Result: Authentication and Admin authorization permit the request to reach the documented pending to confirmed transition behavior. The target order is allowed to change to confirmed. No exact HTTP status, response body, headers, or message is asserted.
Specification Basis: SS-001; SEC-02; SEC-03; API specification lines 173 and 181-182; FR-10 lines 146-149; FR-12 lines 174-179; SEC-02 and SEC-03 at system requirements lines 279-280.
Assumptions / Notes: The order ID and token are controlled fixture values, not specification constants. The JWT claim encoding and all response details are unspecified. Use an inert fixture only; do not expose the token in results.

Test Objective: Verify SS-002 and SEC-02 by denying the security-sensitive Admin mutation when the Authorization header is absent.
Preconditions: A controlled existing order is in pending; record its state before the request.
Request Input: Path id: <existing-pending-order-id>; Authorization header: absent; JSON body: {"status":"confirmed"}.
Expected Result: The operation is not authorized and the target order remains pending. No exact HTTP status, response body, message, or authentication-versus-validation precedence is asserted.
Specification Basis: SS-002; SEC-02; API specification line 173; FR-12 lines 177-179; SEC-02 at system requirements line 279.
Assumptions / Notes: The exact denial response and processing precedence are unspecified. The before/after order-state check supplies the no-mutation oracle.

Specification Basis: SS-004; SEC-03; API specification line 173; FR-12 lines 174-179; SEC-03 at system requirements line 280.
Assumptions / Notes: The non-Admin role name and role-claim encoding are unspecified. The fixture must be a valid JWT except that it lacks role = 'admin'.

Test Objective: Verify the SS-005 SEC-05 behavioral oracle: an injection-shaped path id is handled as data and cannot broaden or redirect the database update.
Preconditions: A valid Admin JWT fixture is available; controlled fixtures allow before/after inspection of all potentially affected orders, including unrelated orders.
Request Input: Path id: <URL-encoded inert fixture equivalent of ' OR '1'='1>; Authorization: Bearer <valid-admin-JWT>; JSON body: {"status":"confirmed"}.
Expected Result: The inert id value does not execute query instructions, select or update unintended orders, or broaden the affected row set. No exact validation, rejection, not-found status, body, or message is asserted.
Specification Basis: SS-005; SEC-05 at system requirements line 282; endpoint path at API specification line 181; FR-18 lines 218-221.
Assumptions / Notes: The example is an inert test string only. ID syntax and response behavior are unspecified. Black-box absence of unintended effects is behavioral evidence but does not conclusively prove source-level parameterization.

Test Objective: Verify the SS-006 SEC-05 behavioral oracle: an injection-shaped status value is handled as data and cannot execute query instructions or bypass lifecycle constraints.

Assumptions / Notes: The concrete string is inert test data. The documented five-state vocabulary establishes that it is unsupported, but exact invalid-value response behavior is unspecified. Behavioral observation cannot conclusively prove source-level parameterization.

Test Objective: Verify the SS-007 valid SEC-05 control: an ordinary valid update affects only the order identified by id.
Preconditions: A controlled target order is in pending; at least one unrelated controlled order exists; a valid Admin JWT fixture is available; record all controlled order states before the request.
Request Input: Path id: <target-pending-order-id>; Authorization: Bearer <valid-admin-JWT>; JSON body: {"status":"confirmed"}.
Expected Result: Only the identified target order performs the documented pending to confirmed transition; unrelated orders remain unchanged. No exact success status, response body, headers, or implementation-level query construction is asserted.
Specification Basis: SS-007; SEC-05 at system requirements line 282; API specification lines 181-182; FR-10 lines 146-149; FR-18 lines 218-221.
Assumptions / Notes: Fixture IDs and JWTs are not specification constants. Before/after inspection supplies the affected-order oracle. This behavioral result does not by itself prove source-level query parameterization.
